definitions: A professional with a broad range of skills and experience across various marketing disciplines rather than specializing in one specific area.
An individual responsible for multiple aspects of marketing, including strategy, content, digital campaigns, and analytics.
examples: The company hired a marketing generalist to oversee all their campaigns.
She started her career as a marketing generalist before specializing in SEO.
A marketing generalist needs to be adaptable and knowledgeable in many areas.
